newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on increased turnover on Friday on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM).
A shares -- distributed to former holders of property rights in the Beirut central district SOLIDERE is rebuilding -- held steady at $105.25.
B shares -- issued in a $650-million subscription in January 1994 -- rose slightly to $106.5 from Thursday's $106.375.
Turnover on BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, rose to 7,066 shares from Thursday's 6,664 and value was $746,591 from $703,104.5.
On the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE), only 200 shares in Ciments Libanais were traded at $1.25 each from $1.2187.
There was no trade in any of the three other listed companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM Stock Index which covers both markets rose 0.36 percent to 911.93 and the LISPI index also rose 0.38 percent to 82.25.
